reviewScope: Bounded independent release/preservation review against MAIN using saved complete Admin manifests, source comparisons and earlier recorded browser/regression evidence. Not exhaustive certification of all 61 differing files or every storefront behavior.

releaseBoundary.composition: 47 inherited + 19 subsequent changes - 5 overlapping paths = 61 distinct differences from MAIN.

featurePreservation.evidence: Both config files and all 20 templates are identical to MAIN. Header sections/snippets, footer-group settings, account/login/register/address/order/reset/activation surfaces are preserved.
featurePreservation.limit: A preserved setting/template is not certification of all external app or account behavior.

featurePreservation.evidence: Header/navigation files are unchanged. Root browser receipts record mobile menu open/Escape, predictive results/Escape, actual Apricot filtering/chip removal and localized hero/category navigation. Search races have focused regressions.
featurePreservation.limit: No new browser replay under the HTTP 429 stop.

featurePreservation.evidence: buy-buttons, price, cart drawer/notification and main-cart-footer files are identical to MAIN. payment_button, named checkout submit, additional checkout buttons, discount and @app rendering remain. Root verified mobile cart placement, quantity/count/subtotal, exact Together Heart variant add and standard desktop/mobile checkout entry.

Only zero-review unsupported arrival/endorsement fallback is removed.
featurePreservation.limit: One review sample, not review authenticity or all-app functional certification.

comparisonWithV8.v7: Uploaded, checksum-bound to all 527 files, with original scoped browser acceptance plus 51 V7 regressions and complete zero-diagnostic Theme Check.
comparisonWithV8.v8: Seven-file local-only overlay, 36 focused offline tests and local full Theme Check; no storefront after-test because public HTTP 429 stop persists.
comparisonWithV8.decision: V7 is the currently supported publication choice. V8 may improve additional localization but must not be silently included or described as rendered/approved live.
